text:
Lina H: quick copy check for the per-route sampling slider tooltip — UX flagged it as confusing. current tooltip: "Controls sample rate for logs and traces per route". feels terse and ambiguous.

Carlos M: yeah users asked: sample *what*? traces? logs? request body? we should be explicit and explain impact on cost.

Ravi S: agree. propose: Visible tooltip short: "Sampling for observability"; expanded hover: "Controls what percent of requests are captured for logs and traces for this route. Increasing this helps debugging but increases storage & billing."

Nora L: wording nit: avoid saying "billing" in tooltips if we can. maybe say "incurs additional storage cost" or "may increase usage costs". also keep visible short label <= 3 words.

Lina H: option A for expanded text (shorter): "Captures a percentage of requests for logs & traces to help debugging. Higher rates increase storage and usage costs."
Option B (explicit target): "Captures request payloads and traces for selected percentage of requests. Useful for debugging spikes; raises storage usage."

Carlos M: prefer A. it's clear enough and avoids jargon like "payloads" which could worry customers.

Ravi S: accessibility: tooltips are keyboard-focusable? we need to ensure the tooltip content is reachable by screen reader. Use aria-describedby on the slider control pointing to the tooltip ID when visible. Also give the slider a visible label: "Observability sampling".

Nora L: suggestion for visible helper text under slider (always visible, short): "Sample rate for logs & traces" and keep tooltip for details on hover/focus. This helps keyboard users who may not trigger hover.

Lina H: finalized microcopy so far:
- visible label: "Observability sampling"
- helper text (always visible): "Sample rate for logs & traces"
- tooltip/expanded (on hover or focus): "Captures a percentage of requests for logs and traces to help debugging. Higher rates increase storage and usage costs."

Carlos M: tiny UX note: add a "Learn more" link in the tooltip to docs page about observability billing and PII redaction. docs link: https://docs.redwood.example/observability/sampling

Ravi S: dev note: implement keyboard access by making the tooltip content a live region only when the slider is focused and the user hits ? or the info button. We shouldn't spam aria-live on hover.

Nora L: accessibility checklist:
- slider has aria-label and aria-describedby to helper text/tooltip
- tooltip content <= 300 chars and plain language
- ensure contrast for helper text and tooltip backgrounds
- include docs link in tooltip with target=_blank and rel=noopener

aria-bot: reminder: add copy to the i18n spreadsheet and flag the tooltip for translation review (short phrases are easier). Run keyboard + screen reader smoke tests on staging.

Lina H: thanks! i've updated the design file and will drop the final copy into Figma and i18n sheet. pinging eng for implementation in the Console repo. :memo:
